ASSAM_FOOD.name: Khar
ASSAM_FOOD.sort: The soul of an Assamese meal
ASSAM_FOOD.about: A distinctive alkaline preparation traditionally made with filtered water from the ash of dried banana peels or stems, often cooked with vegetables.
ASSAM_FOOD.alt: Khar, a traditional alkaline Assamese preparation

ASSAM_FOOD.name: Masor Tenga
ASSAM_FOOD.about: A light sour fish curry; the tang often comes from ingredients such as tomatoes, lemon or elephant apple, depending on the recipe.
ASSAM_FOOD.alt: Masor Tenga, a light sour fish curry from Assam

ASSAM_FOOD.name: Pigu
ASSAM_FOOD.about: Fermented fish from the riverine lowlands — a prized, deeply savoury taste of the Brahmaputra belt.

ASSAM_FOOD.name: Bamboo shoot (Khoa / Khoi)
ASSAM_FOOD.about: Stewed tender bamboo shoot, fragrant with mustard oil — the taste of Assam's hills at every meal.

ASSAM_FOOD.name: Til-pitha · Narikol laru · Payas
ASSAM_FOOD.about: Steamed sweets on banana leaves for Bihu and every celebration — rice, coconut and milk in every guise.

ASSAM_FOOD.name: Assamese Thali
ASSAM_FOOD.about: Khar, masor tenga, duck with bamboo shoot and rice served on banana leaf — the complete Assamese table.
ASSAM_FOOD.alt: The traditional Assamese thali on banana leaf
